name: Stock Zero Report
sql_query:
SELECT
    i.item_code,
    i.item_description,
    c.name                                  AS category_name,
    b.name                                  AS brand_name,
    COALESCE(stk.qty_in_hand, 0)           AS current_qty,
    i.reorder_level,
    i.standard_purchase_price               AS purchase_price,
    i.standard_sales_price                  AS sales_price,
    stk.last_movement_date,
    CASE
        WHEN stk.last_movement_date IS NULL 
            THEN 'Never Stocked'
        WHEN i.reorder_level > 0 AND COALESCE(stk.qty_in_hand, 0) <= i.reorder_level 
            THEN 'Reorder Required'
        ELSE 'Out of Stock'
    END AS stock_status
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = i.category_id
LEFT JOIN m_brands b ON b.id = i.brand_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        m.item_code,
        SUM(m.qun_in - m.qun_out) AS qty_in_hand,
        MAX(m.dDate)              AS last_movement_date
    FROM t_item_movements m
    WHERE m.BC = :bc
      AND (:store_id IS NULL OR m.store_id = :store_id)
      AND (:to IS NULL OR m.dDate <= :to)
    GROUP BY m.item_code
) stk ON stk.item_code = i.item_code
WHERE i.BC = :bc
  AND COALESCE(stk.qty_in_hand, 0) <= 0
  AND (:from IS NULL OR stk.last_movement_date >= :from)
  AND (:category IS NULL OR i.category_id = :category OR c.parent_id = :category)
  AND (:brand_id IS NULL OR i.brand_id = :brand_id)
  AND (:search IS NULL OR i.item_code LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                       OR i.item_description LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%'))
ORDER BY 
    i.reorder_level DESC, 
    stk.last_movement_date DESC, 
    i.item_code ASC;
